method: objdump static disassembly and byte reads; no execution, emulation or microemulation

findings.fieldList: Initialize 0x5220f4 clears field+4 (0x4924fc at 0x522103). Select 0x5222d4 copies region [0x5b5b30] (36 B: four Doubles min/max RA hours, min/max DEC degrees, Single magnitude) into [0x5b5de8], raises +0x20 to 21.5 when lower, then (when [0x5b5838] is set) calls 0x522718.
findings.movingRecords: 0x522718 drops the leading kind-2 run of field+4, asks 0x59940c (front X territory) to refresh the global object list, then copies each leading kind-2 record of [0x5b56ac]+5, projects it with 0x522560 (two Random draws, no bounds test), applies the filter switch (pos0 mag-0.54, pos1 mag+0.65, pos2 none, pos3 mag-0.54, pos4 mag-0.88; result fstp Single) and appends it with 0x492574.
findings.catalogRecords: Update 0x522454 (catalog virtual+4 false -> nothing), virtual+8 selection with [0x5b5de8]; for each selected record: 0x522698 = 0x522560 + inclusive bounds; inside -> record with name, RA/DEC Doubles +0x19/+0x21, Single magnitude +0x29 (catalog +0x35), kind +0x3d = 0, pixel X/Y Doubles +0x47/+0x4f = (plane - origin)/step; appended after the cursor.
findings.fieldObjects: After the catalog, if [0x5b56ac]+0x4b is non-empty, 0x5228dc projects kind-0 global objects with +0x5b set via 0x522698 and computes magnitude = record +0x29 minus colour term 0x51ef38. It then calls 0x522a18, which resets field+4 (0x492628), walks it to the tail (0x492634 until 0x49271c) without keeping a best match and returns ebx: the tail record when the list is non-empty, else the caller's global record (0x522916 mov ebx,ebp). The result is never null, so 0x5228dc always overwrites that record's magnitude (0x522998) and the append branch 0x5229a4..0x5229f9 is unreachable. Not ported: the web offers moving pairs only.
findings.sourceLoop: 0x52154c calls field virtual+8 (update) at 0x52158e before the background loop 0x521635 (one 0x520ec0 draw per pixel, row-major). The source loop 0x521a6f..0x521b35 walks field+4: magnitude +0x29 minus Single 0.25 when filter position 0 (0x521a8d); kind 2 consumes the next record (0x492634) and calls 0x524a6c with both pixel positions; otherwise 0x5245d0.
findings.seeing: CCD compiled record byte +0x5a = 1 (0x5a2bd8); initialize 0x5221be enables the seeing jitter width when it is non-zero.
findings.usnoB1Labels: Catalog initialize 0x59c45c: mode 0 NOMAD (labels B,V,R,J,H,K), mode 1 USNO-B1 (B slot 'B2', R slot 'R2', I slot 'I2'), mode 2 USNO-A2 (B, R). String table 0x59c5e8.
findings.xena: Options default 0x5a26ee copies http://xena.harvard.edu/software/catalogs/tmpsc.html to options+0x20cd; main form +0x2781 (= options base +0x6b4 +0x20cd) is opened by N2MASSCatalog1Click 0x58ec84 via 0x58ebe0. It is the Help > Websites > 2MASS Catalog link, not a camera data source. IR J/H/K come from NOMAD.
findings.regionWriter: The writer of the region record [0x5b5b30] was not located; the web uses whole-sky bounds (selection = magnitude limit).
